action.layout_note: piperx has 7 arm/gripper controls; runtime.action_layout is authoritative.

reset.task_counters: ready; first_contact/last_contact/last_time=None; rest_sec=0; success=False; failure=None; finished=False; display attempt normalized by replay adapter
reset.variation: none; same initial state across all 15 attempts

evaluation.policy_state: one policy per Task Instance; retain and allow learning in both practice and exam; no snapshot rollback; new policy for next Task Instance

spec: robot_id=piperx for this instance track; fixed robot initialization with noise disabled
episode_instance: initial_state (same reset state for all 15 attempts; no sampled variation; round_plan=null)
derived: initial stone and robot state under the fixed reset procedure
ownership.storage_note: Scenario repeats fixed Spec values to reconstruct and validate the environment. Storage in the Task Instance file does not make these values freely variable.

rules.first_contact: any robot/gripper geom touching stone => pushing
rules.release: pushing AND no contact AND time-last_contact >= 0.06 => sliding
failure_checks: any nonfinite position/velocity => invalid_run in replay adapter
x-radius < 0.2 OR x+radius > ice.length_m OR abs(y)+radius > ice.width_m/2 OR z < ice.height_m-0.02 => out_of_bounds
phase=pushing AND release condition false AND time-first_contact > 1.5 => push_too_long
rules.rest: phase=sliding AND no contact AND norm(linear_velocity)<0.015 AND norm(angular_velocity)<0.10; reset accumulated rest to zero when false
rules.success: after continuous rest >=0.6 sec, check norm([x-target.distance_m,y])+stone.radius_m <= target.radius_m at settlement time only, and no failure; containment is not required throughout the rest window
rules.stopped_outside_target: rest >=0.6 sec AND containment false => immediate failure
rules.timeout: at 3000 control steps (60 simulated seconds), if no earlier terminal result: truncated=True, failure=timeout, task_score=0
rules.check_rate: each MuJoCo physics substep, dt=0.002 seconds
rules.failure_priority: failure overrides success on the same substep
